```yaml
name: Backport PR #4063 to release/7.0

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  backport:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up .NET Core
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
      with:
        dotnet-version: '5.0'

    - name: Get current branch
      id: get_branch
      run: echo "::set-output name=branch::$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)"

    - name: Create backport branch
      if: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
      run: git checkout -b backport-4063-to-release-7.0

    - name: Cherry-pick commit
      run: git cherry-pick 9f8e2d3  # Replace with the actual commit hash of PR #4063

    - name: Push backport branch
      if: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
      run: |
        git remote set-url origin https://${{ github.actor }}:${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}@github.com/${{ github.repository }}.git
        git push origin backport-4063-to-release-7.0

    - name: Merge backport into release/7.0
      if: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
      run: |
        git checkout release/7.0
        git merge backport-4063-to-release-7.0
        git push origin release/7.0
```
